subject.title: skill safe-encryption-skill: Spec Prohibits File Output But CLI Tool's Standard Interface Is File Output

question: How should ClawHub handle the live safe-encryption-skill guidance that conflicts with SAFE CLI file-output usage?
rationale: A source patch cannot edit third-party published skill text, and choosing publisher contact, manual moderation, or scanner/content-policy enforcement changes ClawHub's security and content-policy posture.

options.title: Ask publisher to republish clarified guidance
options.body: Preserve publisher ownership while asking for wording that distinguishes safe final ciphertext output from unsafe temporary plaintext or intermediate files.

options.title: Hide or moderate the listing now
options.body: Remove the ambiguous public guidance immediately, but apply a stronger platform action before the publisher has a chance to correct it.

options.title: Add scanner or content-policy treatment
options.body: Use this as a pattern for future ClawScan or policy enforcement, which is broader than fixing this one skill.

recommendation.title: Ask publisher to republish clarified guidance
recommendation.body: Preserve publisher ownership while asking for wording that distinguishes safe final ciphertext output from unsafe temporary plaintext or intermediate files.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the clearest repository-side routing candidate from recent report, moderation, publish, and docs history.
